answer_result.answer: The producer advised Calvin to stay true to himself and sound unique.

question.question: What advice did Calvin receive from the producer at the music festival?

evidence_items.text:
Calvin: Hey Dave! Long time no see. I just went to an awesome music thingy in Tokyo - so cool!
[S3T1] (dia_id: D3:1)

Dave: Hey Calvin! Great to hear from you. How was the music thingy in Tokyo? See any cool bands?
[S3T2] (dia_id: D3:2)

Calvin: Hey Dave! The festival in Tokyo was awesome! Didn't see any bands, but met lots of talented artists and industry people. Totally enriching!
[S3T3] (dia_id: D3:3)

Dave: Wow, Calvin, sounds great! What did you learn from it?
[S3T4] (dia_id: D3:4)

Calvin: I learned a lot and got some great advice from professionals in the music industry. It was inspiring!
[S3T5] (dia_id: D3:5)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Bet that was inspiring being surrounded by professionals. Did you get any advice from them?
[S3T6] (dia_id: D3:6)

Calvin: The producer gave me some advice to stay true to myself and sound unique. It got me thinking about where I want my music to go. It's really motivating!
[S3T7] (dia_id: D3:7)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! It's really motivating to see you staying true to yourself. It got me thinking, where do you see your music taking you?
[S3T8] (dia_id: D3:8)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'm dreaming of touring the world, performing for different people and connecting with them. I hope my music can reach a global audience and make an impact. I'm also looking forward to my upcoming trip to Boston after I finish the Frank Ocean tour. I've heard that the music scene there is awesome, so I can't wait to check it out!
[S3T9] (dia_id: D3:9)

Dave: Sounds like an amazing plan, Cal! I can't wait for your trip to Boston. I'll show you around town and all the cool spots. The music scene there is awesome, with places like Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park. You'll definitely have some great performances there. Count me in for the front row when you're up onstage! Oh, and by the way, check out this pic.
[Image caption: a photography of a city skyline with a boat in the water]
[S3T10] (dia_id: D3:10)

Calvin: Wow, Boston looks great! Thanks for the tips. And, awesome pic!
[S3T11] (dia_id: D3:11)

Dave: Last weekend I went to a car show. Classic cars are so charming and the dedication people put into restoring them is amazing. That's why I'm so into auto engineering. Can't wait to show you some when you come to Boston! Oh, almost forgot to send a photo, look at this beautiful car!
[Image caption: a photography of a green mustang parked in a field of grass]
[S3T12] (dia_id: D3:12)

- On 2023-05-01, expressed that it's an amazing feeling when something you create resonates with people, and satisfying to finish something made from scratch — the same joy he finds in seeing a creation come to life [S4T10][S4T12].
- Has a home music studio where he "pour[s] [his] heart into the music"; shared a photo of it (keyboard, synthesizer, and other musical equipment) while telling Dave about the house flood [S6T5].
- On 2023-05-03, said he's stuck with his music — "like [his] creativity's frozen" — and asked Dave for tips; said he'll take Dave's advice (take a break from music and explore other things for fun) to get his "mojo" back, and affirmed he won't give up on his music [S5T10][S5T11][S5T12][S5T14].
- On 2023-05-16, "super excited" for the Tokyo performance happening this month (May 2023) — a chance to show his music to a whole new crowd and hopefully expand his following (details in ## Tokyo trip) [S6T11]. The tour went ahead: as of 2023-05-31 he had been touring with Frank Ocean the week before (see ## Tokyo trip) [S7T1].
- As of 2023-06-09, has an album in progress ("my album"); met with the creative team for it on 2023-06-08 — "a long session, but awesome to see everything coming together", and he's "feeling stoked" and "making some magic" in the studio working on the music and everything. He shared a photo of the studio (a recording studio with a large window and a desk) [S8T1][S8T3].

Dave: Hey Calvin! Haven't talked in a while! Last Friday I had a card-night with my friends, it was so much fun. We laughed and had a great time! Take a look at the photo!
[Image caption: a photography of a group of men sitting at a table with playing cards]
[S15T1] (dia_id: D15:1)

Calvin: Hey Dave! Great to hear from you, card night sounds like a blast! Always love having fun with friends. Guess what? I scored a deal to continue collaboration with Frank Ocean! This is a dream come true for me, I've been working hard and it's finally paying off. No words can describe how happy I am.
[S15T2] (dia_id: D15:2)

Dave: Wow Calvin, congrats! Super excited for you. How did this chance come up?
[S15T3] (dia_id: D15:3)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I had the opportunity to meet Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo and we clicked. We've been speaking and sharing ideas we arranged a meeting and recorded a song in the studio at my mansion - it's been great!
[S15T4] (dia_id: D15:4)

Dave: Wow, Tokyo sounds like an incredible experience!
[S15T5] (dia_id: D15:5)

Calvin: It was an incredible experience, Dave! The city was buzzing with energy and the festival crowd was so lively - it was like fuel for my soul. Look at this photo, that's amazing!
[Image caption: a photo of a crowd of people sitting on the grass at night]
[S15T6] (dia_id: D15:6)

Dave: Wow, that sounds incredible! What was it like playing at the festival? Must have been an amazing experience.
[S15T7] (dia_id: D15:7)

Calvin: It was a dream come true, Dave! The festival had buzzing energy and a super upbeat crowd. We all felt connected, it was amazing!
[S15T8] (dia_id: D15:8)

Dave: Sounds like you had a blast! Did any other collaborations come out of that performance? Any upcoming concerts we should know about?
[S15T9] (dia_id: D15:9)

Calvin: Yeah Dave, someone even noticed my performance and now we're working together, which is wild. My tour ends soon and I'm heading to Boston. Maybe we can meet up then!
[S15T10] (dia_id: D15:10)

Dave: Sounds great! Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!
[S15T11] (dia_id: D15:11)

Calvin: Of course, Dave can't wait to catch up! I almost forgot, yesterday my friends and I recorded a podcast where we discuss the rapidly evolving rap industry!
[S15T12] (dia_id: D15:12)

- As of 2023-04-20 he is in Tokyo, Japan, fulfilling his planned trip: attended a music festival he called "awesome" — no bands, but met lots of talented artists and industry people, which he found totally enriching [S3T1][S3T3].
- Learned a lot and got great advice from professionals in the music industry; found it inspiring [S3T5].
- A producer advised him to stay true to himself and sound unique; it made him think about where he wants his music to go and is motivating him [S3T7].
- On 2023-05-16, still in Tokyo: shared a photo of the Tokyo night skyline taken "last night" (2023-05-15) — "the skyline was stunning"; Dave praised the shot and said he has to take a trip to Tokyo soon [S6T13][S6T14][S6T15][S6T16]. Calvin thanked Dave and said the city lights in Tokyo are amazing, encouraging Dave to visit — "it's awesome!" [S6T17].
- As of 2023-05-16, he has an upcoming performance in Tokyo "this month" (May 2023) he is "super excited" for — great to show his music to a whole new crowd and hopefully expand his following [S6T11].

Dave: That's a great guitar, Calvin! Love the design, it's so unique and special.
[S16T15] (dia_id: D16:15)

Calvin: Cheers, mate! Really appreciate it. This guitar means so much to me; it's a reminder of my passion for music and the amazing friendships I've made.
[S16T16] (dia_id: D16:16)

Dave: Wow, Calvin, this instrument obviously means a lot to you - it's like a representation of your journey, your passion for music, and the friendships you've made. Amazing!
[S16T17] (dia_id: D16:17)

Calvin: Yeah, Dave! It's like every mark and strum holds a story. Take a look.
[Image caption: a photo of a guitar with a purple glow on it]
[S16T18] (dia_id: D16:18)

Dave: That guitar has a gorgeous purple hue. Why did you make it so shiny?
[S16T19] (dia_id: D16:19)

Calvin: I got it customized with a shiny finish because it gives it a unique look. Plus, it goes with my style.
[S16T20] (dia_id: D16:20)

Dave: Good pick! The customized purple glow gives it a unique look that really stands out.
[S16T21] (dia_id: D16:21)

Calvin: Thanks, dude! I dig how it's so unique. It's totally my style!
[S16T22] (dia_id: D16:22)

Dave: Looks great on you! Your unique style really stands out in your music and playing.
[S16T23] (dia_id: D16:23)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Trying to stay true to myself and be unique in my music is something that I value, so it's really great to hear that you appreciate it.
[S16T24] (dia_id: D16:24)

Dave: Definitely, staying true to yourself and your style is vital. It makes you unique and your music stand out. Keep it real, bud. You've got something great to give the world.
[Image caption: a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage]
[S16T25] (dia_id: D16:25)

- On 2023-03-26, congratulated Calvin on his new luxury car [S2T2][S2T6]; later that day asked Calvin what's new in his life after their talk about the festival and his favorite band [S2T16].
- On 2023-03-26, looking forward to hearing Calvin's new tunes and asked him to keep him updated on his collaborations [S2T18][S2T20].
- On 2023-04-20, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see"), who reported back from a Tokyo music festival; Dave reacted enthusiastically and asked what Calvin learned and where he sees his music taking him [S3T1][S3T2][S3T4][S3T6][S3T8].
- On 2023-05-31, caught up with Calvin ("been ages since we chatted"); congratulated Calvin on the Frank Ocean tour (Tokyo stop; details in /memories/calvin.md) [S7T1][S7T2]. Shared a photo of himself fixing a neighbor's car engine in a garage (details in ## Car maintenance shop) and told Calvin that working on cars is "definitely therapeutic"; Calvin said fixing cars calms him down "like meditating" and asked whether Dave has hobbies with the same satisfaction — Dave described his passion for fixing up things as more than a hobby, giving purpose and a sense of achievement (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S7T2][S7T4][S7T5][S7T6]. The exchange ended with the two agreeing that transforming something and giving it a new life makes them feel like they "really achieved something" [S7T7][S7T8]. The 2023-05-31 conversation continued: Calvin echoed the "feeling of power and happiness" ("It's great to see what we created with all our hard work and ideas") [S7T9]; Dave asked whether Calvin always enjoys performing live (Calvin: it "always fuels my soul" — an "absolute high") [S7T10][S7T11], and Dave marveled at the artist-audience connection and the concert crowd photos Calvin shared (a large crowd taking pictures; a crowd watching a concert with bright lights; a band on stage), calling the atmosphere "off the charts" and saying music "brings people together ... like therapy for us all" [S7T12][S7T13][S7T14]; when Dave asked what's next for Calvin's music, Calvin named the Boston stop on the Frank Ocean tour, and Dave said he'll be there to cheer him on (details in ## Boston) [S7T14][S7T15][S7T16]. The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave for his support and saying he can't wait to experience the Boston music scene; Dave wished Calvin a great time in Boston and said he can't wait to hear all about it when he gets back, and Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details, signing off "See you soon!" [S7T17][S7T18][S7T19].
- On 2023-04-20, continued the catch-up: offered to show Calvin around Boston (Paradise Rock, House of Blues, Fenway Park), said he'll be in the front row when Calvin performs, and agreed to grab food at his favorite spots when Calvin visits (details in ## Boston) [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16]. Calvin shared a photo of his red sports car on display at a show, and Dave praised the work put into it [S3T13][S3T14].
